name: ExtractIocs
description: Extract hashes, IPs, domains, URLs and email addresses from text or a file, refanging defanged forms such as hxxp and [.]. Unlike every other action here, this never calls the PolySwarm API: local only, costs nothing, spends no quota.

text.description: Text to extract indicators from. Supply this or a file, not both. Nothing is sent to PolySwarm: this runs locally and spends no quota.

file.description: Name of a text file to extract indicators from, relative to the run data directory where Sekoia delivers it. Supply this or text, not both. Nothing is sent to PolySwarm: this runs locally and spends no quota.

ipv4.description: Routable IPv4 addresses found in the text

ipv6.description: Routable IPv6 addresses found in the text

domain.description: Domain names found on their own, excluding those that only appear inside a URL or an email address

url.description: URLs found in the text, refanged and with trailing sentence punctuation removed

md5.description: MD5 hashes found in the text

sha1.description: SHA1 hashes found in the text

sha256.description: SHA256 hashes found in the text

email.description: Email addresses found in the text

reserved_ip.description: Private, loopback, link local, multicast and other reserved addresses, reported separately from the routable ones rather than dropped

total_count.description: Total number of indicators returned across every list, including the reserved addresses
